title: Real Linux shell: make the tunnel permanent in ~/.ssh/config
instruction: This is a REAL Linux box running entirely in your browser. Typing the long `ssh -L ...` every time is tedious, turn it into an alias. Create /root/.ssh/config with a Host entry named `db` that sets `HostName example.com` and `LocalForward 3306 localhost:3306`. Then click Verify. (Tip: busybox has vi, or just use printf/cat.)

verify.success: Solved! With this config, `ssh db` opens the local forward automatically, no flags to remember.
verify.fail: Not yet. /root/.ssh/config must contain both 'HostName example.com' and 'LocalForward 3306 localhost:3306'.

hint:
mkdir -p /root/.ssh && printf 'Host db
  HostName example.com
  LocalForward 3306 localhost:3306
' > /root/.ssh/config
